salary_details.details: Fixed monthly remuneration is specified for several posts: Medical Officer (Rs. 95,000/-), Medical Specialist (Rs. 1,30,000/-), Pharmacist (Rs. 36,500/-), Driver (Rs. 25,600/-), Clerk (Rs. 29,200/-), Data Entry Operator (Rs. 29,200/- or Rs. 21,800/- depending on location), and Peon (Rs. 21,800/-). For the remaining posts, the notice does not print a separate remuneration figure against that row; candidates should check the official notice or www.echs.gov.in for confirmation before applying.

selection_process: Screening of applications against the minimum qualification

age and experience criteria for each post. Only screened candidates meeting the qualitative requirements will be called telephonically for an interview. Candidates must appear for the interview with all original certificates
mark sheets and documents. No TA/DA (travelling/dearness allowance) is admissible for attending the interview. Selected candidates for the posts of Medical Officer

Gynaecologist and Dental Officer will be required to undergo 10 days of On-the-Job Training (OJT)/handing-taking over and obtain a certificate from a Medical Officer of the ECHS Polyclinic before signing the contract. Reservation will be given to Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and Widows of service personnel
as per the criteria in the notification.
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted only in physical/offline form, as per the prescribed format, along with self-attested photocopies of the required documents. Candidates should follow these steps:
Download the application form and format from the official website, www.echs.gov.in.
Fill the application form as per the prescribed format for the post applied for.
Attach self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates, PAN card, Aadhaar card, and work experience certificates.
Attach the original copy of a latest medical certificate signed by SEMO/CMO, and a character certificate.
If currently working with any Army organisation, attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned Station Cell.
Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates must also attach a copy of the Discharge Book and PPO (Pension Payment Order).
Submit the complete application in physical form to the Officer-in-Charge (OIC), Station HQ (ECHS), Ambala Cantt, on or before 11 August 2026, 01:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Ambala Cantt Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Minimum qualification differs by post - ranging from a basic literacy/8th-pass requirement for posts like Safaiwala and Chowkidar, to professional degrees such as MBBS for Medical Officer, BDS for Dental Officer, and MD/MS/DNB for Medical Specialist. Most Para-Medical and Non-Medical posts also require a specific Armed Forces trade course or equivalent civilian diploma along with a minimum number of years of relevant experience. Full post-wise qualification details are listed in the vacancy table above. Each post carries two age figures in the notification: the age limit "for employment" and a higher age limit "for contractual service." Age limits range from 53-55 years (Driver, Clerk, Data Entry Operator, Receptionist, Peon, Chowkidar, Safaiwala) to 68-70 years (Medical Specialist, Gynaecologist, Radiologist). The engagement itself is contractual for 12/11 months, renewable until the candidate reaches the maximum age specified for that post, subject to performance and other conditions.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Ambala Cantt Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Fixed monthly remuneration is specified for several posts: Medical Officer (Rs. 95,000/-), Medical Specialist (Rs. 1,30,000/-), Pharmacist (Rs. 36,500/-), Driver (Rs. 25,600/-), Clerk (Rs. 29,200/-), Data Entry Operator (Rs. 29,200/- or Rs. 21,800/- depending on location), and Peon (Rs. 21,800/-). For the remaining posts, the notice does not print a separate remuneration figure against that row; candidates should check the official notice or www.echs.gov.in for confirmation before applying.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Ambala Cantt Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process, as per the notification, involves the following stages: Screening of applications against the minimum qualification, age and experience criteria for each post. Only screened candidates meeting the qualitative requirements will be called telephonically for an interview. Candidates must appear for the interview with all original certificates, mark sheets and documents. No TA/DA (travelling/dearness allowance) is admissible for attending the interview. Selected candidates for the posts of Medical Officer, Radiologist, Gynaecologist and Dental Officer will be required to undergo 10 days of On-the-Job Training (OJT)/handing-taking over and obtain a certificate from a Medical Officer of the ECHS Polyclinic before signing the contract. Reservation will be given to Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and Widows of service personnel, including War Widows (Veer Naris), as per the criteria in the notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Ambala Cantt Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only in physical/offline form, as per the prescribed format, along with self-attested photocopies of the required documents. Candidates should follow these steps: Download the application form and format from the official website, www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form as per the prescribed format for the post applied for. Attach self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates, PAN card, Aadhaar card, and work experience certificates. Attach the original copy of a latest medical certificate signed by SEMO/CMO, and a character certificate. If currently working with any Army organisation, attach a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned Station Cell. Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates must also attach a copy of the Discharge Book and PPO (Pension Payment Order). Submit the complete application in physical form to the Officer-in-Charge (OIC), Station HQ (ECHS), Ambala Cantt, on or before 11 August 2026, 01:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: ECHS Ambala Cantt Apply Online/ Application Mode
content_sections.text: There is no online application (apply-online) facility for this recruitment. As per the notification, applications are accepted "in only physical form" at the office of the OIC, Station HQ (ECHS), Ambala Cantt. The application form itself, along with terms, conditions and full eligibility details, is available for download on www.echs.gov.in. Candidates who have completed their postgraduate degree in life sciences can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and M.Sc Life Sciences Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for more research opportunities can also explore the latest Haryana Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings closer to the NCR region can check Ambala Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those holding a postgraduate degree in science can also browse more M.Sc Government Jobs and Research Fellow Jobs matching their qualification.
